description: This file defines the 'Process' class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, including nested 'Options' class, for managing process creation, control, and I/O operations across Windows and Linux platforms. It includes methods for launching, killing, waiting for processes, and handling process I/O streams.

classes.name: Process
classes.description: Represents a system process, providing methods to launch, terminate, check status, and handle I/O streams, with platform-specific implementations for Windows and Linux.

classes.name: Process::Options
classes.description: Encapsulates command-line options for process execution, including methods to add, remove, and serialize options into command-line arguments.

methods.name: Process::IsActive
methods.description: Checks if the process is currently active/running.

methods.name: Process::HasConnector
methods.description: Indicates if the process has an active I/O connector.

methods.name: Process::Input
methods.description: Returns the handle to the process's input stream.

methods.name: Process::Output
methods.description: Returns the handle to the process's output stream.

methods.name: Process::Error
methods.description: Returns the handle to the process's error stream.

methods.name: Process::IsKilled
methods.description: Checks if the process was killed.

methods.name: Process::IsTerminated
methods.description: Checks if the process has terminated.

methods.name: Process::Launch
methods.description: Starts the process with specified options and retrieves its process ID.

methods.name: Process::Kill
methods.description: Terminates the process, optionally with a hard kill.

methods.name: Process::WaitProcessCompleted
methods.description: Waits for the process to complete within a specified timeout.
